newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close mixed.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed mixed on Saturday on buying by exporters and are likely to open steady on Monday after Sunday's weekend holiday, dealers at the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
The exporters, who want to fulfil their shipment commitments, had purchased the NIAB-78 variety, which is considered inferior to some other varieties, one dealer said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 was quoted at 1,950/2,050 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 at 2,300/2,375 and the MNH-93 at 2,325/2,375.
